mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order_evidence (order_id, stage, image_url, operator_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{stage}, #{imageUrl}, #{operatorId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, stage, image_url AS imageUrl, operator_id AS operatorId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM t_order_evidence WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_order_evidence WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND stage=#{stage} AND deleted_at IS NULL
